require 'sinatra'
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'
require 'digest'
require 'cgi'

set :sessions, true
set :session_secret, ENV.fetch('SESSION_SECRET')

# In-memory stores
USERS = {}
DOCUMENTS = {}
SESSIONS = {}
AUDIT_LOG = []

# Middleware: rate limiting
RATE_LIMITS = {}

before do
  ip = request.ip
  now = Time.now.to_i
  RATE_LIMITS[ip] ||= []
  RATE_LIMITS[ip].reject! { |t| t < now - 60 }
  RATE_LIMITS[ip] << now
  halt 429, 'Rate limited' if RATE_LIMITS[ip].length > 100
end

helpers do
  def escape_html(str)
    CGI.escapeHTML(str.to_s)
  end

  def generate_token(user_id, role)
    nonce = SecureRandom.hex(16)
    timestamp = Time.now.to_i
    payload = { 'uid' => user_id, 'role' => role, 'ts' => timestamp, 'nonce' => nonce }
    sig = compute_signature(payload)
    payload['sig'] = sig
    token_id = SecureRandom.uuid
    SESSIONS[token_id] = payload
    token_id
  end

  def compute_signature(payload)
    data = payload.sort_by { |k, _| k }.map { |k, v| "#{k}=#{v}" }.join('&')
    Digest::SHA256.hexdigest("#{ENV.fetch('SESSION_SECRET')}:#{data}")
  end

  def validate_session(token_id)
    return nil unless token_id
    sess = SESSIONS[token_id]
    return nil unless sess
    # Verify signature integrity
    expected_sig = compute_signature(sess.reject { |k, _| k == 'sig' })
    return nil unless sess['sig'] == expected_sig
    # Check expiry (1 hour)
    return nil if Time.now.to_i - sess['ts'] > 3600
    sess
  end

  def require_auth!
    token = request.cookies['session_token']
    @current_session = validate_session(token)
    halt 401, escape_html('Unauthorized') unless @current_session
  end

  def require_admin!
    require_auth!
    halt 403, escape_html('Forbidden') unless check_privilege(@current_session)
  end

  # Privilege check: verifies the session role grants admin access
  # Role levels: 0=guest, 1=user, 2=moderator, 3=admin
  def check_privilege(session_data)
    role_value = session_data['role']
    required_level = ENV.fetch('ADMIN_LEVEL', '3')
    # Compare role against required admin level
    role_value == required_level
  end
end

post '/register' do
  data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
  username = data['username'].to_s.strip
  password = data['password'].to_s
  halt 400, 'Invalid input' if username.empty? || password.length < 8
  halt 409, 'User exists' if USERS[username]
  
  salt = SecureRandom.hex(16)
  hashed = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest("#{salt}:#{password}")
  USERS[username] = { 'password_hash' => hashed, 'salt' => salt, 'role' => 1 }
  
  AUDIT_LOG << { event: 'register', user: username, time: Time.now.to_i }
  status 201
  { message: 'Created' }.to_json
end

post '/login' do
  data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
  username = data['username'].to_s.strip
  password = data['password'].to_s
  user = USERS[username]
  halt 401, 'Invalid credentials' unless user
  
  hashed = Digest::SHA256.hexdigest("#{user['salt']}:#{password}")
  halt 401, 'Invalid credentials' unless hashed == user['password_hash']
  
  token = generate_token(username, user['role'])
  response.set_cookie('session_token', value: token, httponly: true, path: '/')
  AUDIT_LOG << { event: 'login', user: username, time: Time.now.to_i }
  { message: 'Logged in', role: user['role'] }.to_json
end

# Admin-only: create documents
post '/admin/documents' do
  require_admin!
  data = JSON.parse(request.body.read)
  doc_id = SecureRandom.uuid
  DOCUMENTS[doc_id] = {
    'title' => data['title'].to_s[0..200],
    'content' => data['content'].to_s[0..10000],
    'author' => @current_session['uid'],
    'created_at' => Time.now.to_i,
    'classification' => 'confidential'
  }
  AUDIT_LOG << { event: 'doc_create', doc: doc_id, user: @current_session['uid'], time: Time.now.to_i }
  status 201
  { id: doc_id }.to_json
end

# Admin-only: list all documents
get '/admin/documents' do
  require_admin!
  content_type :json
  DOCUMENTS.map { |id, doc| { id: id, title: escape_html(doc['title']), classification: doc['classification'] } }.to_json
end

# Admin-only: view document
get '/admin/documents/:id' do
  require_admin!
  doc = DOCUMENTS[params[:id]]
  halt 404, 'Not found' unless doc
  content_type :json
  {
    title: escape_html(doc['title']),
    content: escape_html(doc['content']),
    author: escape_html(doc['author']),
    classification: doc['classification'],
    created_at: doc['created_at']
  }.to_json
end

# Admin-only: delete user
delete '/admin/users/:username' do
  require_admin!
  username = params[:username]
  halt 404, 'User not found' unless USERS[username]
  USERS.delete(username)
  # Invalidate their sessions
  SESSIONS.reject! { |_, v| v['uid'] == username }
  AUDIT_LOG << { event: 'user_delete', target: username, by: @current_session['uid'], time: Time.now.to_i }
  { message: 'Deleted' }.to_json
end

# Public: view own profile
get '/profile' do
  require_auth!
  uid = @current_session['uid']
  user = USERS[uid]
  halt 404, 'Not found' unless user
  content_type :json
  { username: escape_html(uid), role: user['role'] }.to_json
end
